entries.title: Pullback Continuation Independent Alpha and Portfolio Portability Study
entries.target_failure_mode: Determine whether the fixed CSOS J_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION opportunity family can be translated to one source-native executable candidate with stable event identity before standalone, concentration, portfolio, historical, Core/MT4 or 2025 gates.
entries.causal_hypothesis: A strong EMA-separated USDJPY trend that retraces to EMA20 and completes a directional confirmation bar contains a 16-M15-bar continuation edge that survives executable Bid/Ask translation and improves fixed-lot B02/F05 portfolio risk even without strict hedge behavior.
pre_result_predictions: The fixed Atlas event set should reproduce at least 95% on the binding Dukascopy Tick source.
Any source mismatch should be fully attributable without selective event exclusion.
If identity passes, Long and Short should remain jointly eligible and all downstream economics should be evaluated without retuning.
Portfolio benefit may coexist with positive daily correlation but must pass realized and full-equity risk gates.
tests: Exact CSOS Atlas contract and 1,333-event reproduction
2023-2024 Dukascopy BI5 Bid/Ask source inventory and M15 reconstruction audit
Atlas-versus-source-native event identity and mismatch attribution
First-binding-failure stop before executable economics and protected periods
retained_findings: The Atlas evaluator and 1,333-event diagnostic result were reproduced exactly before binding source translation.
2024 Atlas identity was exact at 669/669 events on the aligned public Bid/Ask-derived lineage.
All 299 signal-set mismatches occurred in 2023, where the Atlas used Rakuten M15 while the binding study source was Dukascopy BI5 Tick.
Cross-venue OHLC differences recursively altered EMA20, EMA96, ATR20 and same-variant active suppression chronology.
falsified_or_unsupported_claims: The fixed J_PULLBACK_CONTINUATION Atlas event population is source-native portable across 2023-2024.
The 2023 Rakuten M15 opportunity population can be treated as equivalent to Dukascopy Tick reconstruction.
The candidate may proceed to executable economics, candidate freeze, historical validation, Core/MT4 or 2025.
prohibited_reuse: hold-time, Exit, SL or TP optimization
combination with Sweep, HYP-033 or HYP-034 features
lot-size rescue after a fixed-lot gate
2020-2022 or 2025 outcome access for HYP-035 rescue
selective removal of Atlas-only or raw-native-only events
successor_questions: Can a newly preregistered pullback-continuation family discovered entirely on one source-native venue establish independent alpha without reusing HYP-035 outcome-defined exclusions?
entries.exact_next_action: Close HYP-035 at Atlas identity. Do not rescue the fixed candidate; any successor must be a new single-venue source-native hypothesis.
